message.what: A significant solar flare has occurred from Active Region 3664. Initial imagery indicates that a coronal mass ejection may have been produced.
message.when: Analysis is underway at 0630 UTC Wed May 08 2024. If an Earth-directed component is confirmed, potential Earth impacts would not be expected before 1200 UTC Fri May 10 2024. Timing will be refined as imagery and model guidance become available.
message.confidence: Low. No calibrated arrival probability is assigned while eruption analysis remains incomplete.
message.impacts: If an Earth-directed coronal mass ejection is confirmed, geomagnetic activity could affect HF communication, satellite navigation, satellite operations, and power systems, particularly at higher latitudes.
message.additional_details: Active Region 3664 remains large, complex, and capable of additional eruptions. No Space Weather Watch or Warning is in effect for this event at 0630 UTC Wed May 08 2024. A Watch may be issued if imagery and model guidance support G3 or greater conditions.
message.next_update: No later than 1800 UTC Wed May 08 2024, or sooner if conditions change.
